notes.title: Within Whispers - The Fall RELEASED!
notes.content:
Finally! Within Whispers - The Fall is released. After all delays and issues that we had, we succeed to release this episode. Already, we are about to start working on the second episode In the new episode you will see when the real adventure is going to happen. Enjoy the game you have waited for so long! 
Stay safe!

notes.title: Are you ready?
notes.content:
The spirit world is separate from ours for a reason, there are spirits and ghosts living there that have no place in "our world". Hearing and talking to ghosts does not come naturally to most of us, and it might be scary just thinking about it. A séance or seance is an attempt to communicate with spirits. People who have that ability are sometimes called mediums or channelers because they channel communication from the dead to the living. Thus, we need faith to achieve communication with ghosts and Aska surely has the ability to communicate and also she has faith in that her brother Felix is alive. 
If you want to know what happened with Felix you will be able to find out soon! 
We are extremely close to ending this long journey! After a few years of hardworking, laughing, stressing, arguing and having a great time, after all, we can say that we are very proud. We are thrilled by your positive feedback! Thank you for your time, patience and most of all, thank you for the support! 
The release date is coming down the pike!

notes.title: Within Whispers SOON!
notes.content:
Hello guys! 

It has been a while since we wrote last time. Unfortunately. 
Sorry about the delay, it will not happen again. Pinky promise! :D 
Finally, we have some updates about "Within Whispers - The Fall"! Firstly, we would like to share with you, the game release will be in the third quarter of this year! (This time for real, it is not a joke! :D) 
Our team is working on this project constantly, we added and changed a lot of things. We added  95% mockup animations, we changed gameplay a little bit, improved graphic, optimized the game and that took a lot of time. 
Also, because you waited too long, we do not want to disappoint you, guys. For that reason, we want to do it right and meet your expectations. That is the most important thing for us, and your commitment keeps us motivated! :) 

Now, we also made a Facebook page "Within Whispers" where we will post news every week until the game release. 

Like "Within Whispers" page and the updates are upcoming! :)

https://www.facebook.com/Within-Whispers-375877249690554/

notes.title: WITHIN WHISPERS DELAYED
notes.content:
Making games isn’t so easy. 

Despite all hands working, sometimes the game, you’re looking forward to, gets pushed back for some time.   Keeping that in mind, we apologize to everyone because this delay. 

We had hoped to have the game sooner, but, unfortunately, we require an extra time to make a whole game looks flawless. 

We're expecting the game release in October, but, as soon as we know an exact date, we will announce it. 

Thanks for your patience and we promise the waiting will be worth it.

notes.title: Experience the Devastating Effects of War in Within Whispers - The Fall
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30440756/917beb19eddb5635d36aebad2c8477a4fb35ba55.png[/img]

Very recent blog post about upcoming Within Whispers: The Fall on "Games Lands"! Thank you! 

If you are looking for an emotional roller coaster of an adventure game that's just like Telltale's stuff, you might be interested in Within Whispers - The Fall.

Developed by Thorium Studios, Within Whispers - The Fall is the first installment of a rather poignant series of narrative-driven, 3D point-and-click adventure games that lets you follow the journey of a young lady, Aska, whose brother has gone missing while serving his country at the front lines of the Great War. She also happens to have the unique ability to see dead soldiers.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30440756/d5417038ed95eef83dd97115a5f05bcd7673e50f.jpg[/img]

Similar to Telltale's renowned storytelling ability, this game is designed to follow in Telltale's footsteps in detailing not only the heart-wrenching devastation of war and how it affects the people involved; it also lets you have a say in deciding the path of the narrative - you literally get to make important decisions in the game that will change the course of the story and hence, its ending. Not to mention, aside from all the more depressing sights, the game even has some more lighthearted and serene moments where you can simply enjoy the beauty of Eastern Europe depicted in colorful, comic book-like art.

So if you're interested in insightful, war-themed adventures where your emotions will be placed on a rollercoaster of a storyline, you might want to keep an eye on Within Whispers - The Fall. The game is slated to be released in April 2018 and will be available for purchase on Steam.

[url=http://www.mysteryvale.com/blog/post/experience_the_devastating_effects_of_war_in_within_whispers_the_fall]This is the link to the original announcement piece[/url]

notes.title: Within Whispers set to make noise on PC next spring
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30440756/a2ac2cda0341fa3c8e0b244240408203e7baa1d0.png[/img]
Recently, guys from Adventure Gamers contacted us and said that they are liking the outlook of the game and that they would like to make an announcement piece about us and Within Whispers: The Fall. We couldn’t be more excited about that, since this is the first world-wide announcement that we received!

The article is looking pretty sweet, have a look at the text here:

“It's been a whole century since the first World War, but its horrors have still (rightly) not been forgotten. Helping to keep those memories alive is a new episodic adventure called Within Whispers, set to debut next spring on PC.

Within Whispers casts players in the role of a young medic named Aska, whose brother was sent to the front and has since disappeared. Now Aska is determined to find out what happened to him, which means bravely venturing into the "trenches and battlefields of the Great War" herself, where so many have fallen on both sides. This would be horrific for anyone to witness, but Aska has a unique gift that lets her "see and communicate with ghosts of dead soldiers." In hearing their untold stories and "struggling with this unusual 'gift', there is one ghost she is hoping not to meet."

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30440756/b18c06b4a5ced8c3f5198eb88fdbf227f9a894e7.png[/img]

Described by indie Serbian developer Thorium Studios as a "narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game," it's clear that Within Whispers has been inspired by the choice-and-consequence form of storytelling popularized by Telltale. The 3D graphics are done in a "comic book art style" that depicts the wartime paradox melding "beautiful sceneries of peaceful European countryside, and terrifying devastations." Along the way there will be many supernatural interactions, presenting multiple choice dialogue options that can make your life either harder or easier. Players will also need to solve puzzles and overcome a number of Quick Time Events in order to complete various objectives.

A total of four episodes are planned in total, each with its own distinct setting and storyline, although unified by a larger narrative arc. The series debut, subtitled The Fall, is currently on track for Steam release on PC next April.”

[url=https://adventuregamers.com/news/view/33668] This is the link to the original announcement piece	[/url]

We would like to say a big thanks to everyone at Adventure Gamers for this opportunity, for taking their time to write something about Within Whispers and for being so affable and nice towards us!
We really appreciate it!
